name: dbsnp_get_variant_by_rsid
description: Get variant information from dbSNP by rsID. Returns genomic coordinates, alleles, and basic variant information. Coordinates are reported on BOTH assemblies: 'position'/'position_grch38' are on GRCh38 (dbSNP's current assembly, named by the 'assembly' field) and 'position_grch37' is the same variant on GRCh37. Always pick the field matching your pipeline's build -- the two can differ by hundreds of kilobases.

data.description: Variant information from dbSNP, flattened from the NCBI E-utilities esummary document summary

refsnp_id.description: dbSNP reference ID, with the 'rs' prefix (e.g. 'rs80338939')

snp_id.description: Numeric dbSNP ID without the 'rs' prefix (e.g. 80338939)

position.description: Genomic coordinate on GRCh38 as a 'chromosome:position' STRING (e.g. '13:20189547'), not an integer. Identical to 'position_grch38'; see the 'assembly' field for the build label. Retained under this name for backwards compatibility.

assembly.description: Genome assembly that 'position' and 'position_grch38' are expressed on. Always 'GRCh38', dbSNP's current assembly.

position_grch38.description: Genomic coordinate on GRCh38 as a 'chromosome:position' string, from esummary 'chrpos'. Same value as 'position', explicitly labelled.

position_grch37.description: Genomic coordinate for the same variant on GRCh37 (hg19) as a 'chromosome:position' string, from esummary 'chrpos_prev_assm'. Null when dbSNP has no previous-assembly mapping. Use this, not 'position', for GRCh37/hg19 pipelines.

allele.description: Variant allele as reported by dbSNP

clinical_significance.description: ClinVar clinical significance terms (e.g. 'pathogenic'). A single-element list containing an empty string when dbSNP reports none.

genes.description: Symbols of genes overlapping the variant

allele_frequencies.description: Raw per-study frequency entries from esummary 'global_mafs', UNPARSED. Use dbsnp_get_frequencies for parsed numeric values.

freq.description: Raw dbSNP encoding 'allele=frequency/allele_count', e.g. '-=0.002396/12'. The number after the slash is an ALLELE (chromosome) count, not a number of individuals.

hgvs_notation.description: dbSNP 'docsum' string. Not bare HGVS: a pipe-delimited record whose first segment is 'HGVS=' followed by a comma-separated list of HGVS expressions, then SEQ=/LEN=/GENE= segments. Parse before use.

rsid.description: Input rsID, normalized to include the 'rs' prefix

name: dbsnp_search_by_gene
description: Search for variants in a specific gene. Returns variants associated with the gene symbol.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

data.description: Search results from dbSNP. This endpoint returns IDENTIFIERS ONLY -- no coordinates, alleles, or gene annotation. Call dbsnp_get_variant_by_rsid on an rsID to get its details.

refsnp_id.description: dbSNP reference ID, with the 'rs' prefix (e.g. 'rs2500267164')

snp_id.description: Numeric dbSNP ID without the 'rs' prefix

total_count.description: Total number of variants matching the gene query in dbSNP, which is typically far larger than the number returned

returned_count.description: Number of variants actually returned, capped by the 'limit' parameter

name: dbsnp_get_frequencies
description: Get allele frequencies for a variant from dbSNP. Returns population-specific allele frequency data. Each study reports an 'allele_count' -- the number of ALLELES (chromosomes) observed carrying the allele, NOT a number of individuals. Do not read it as study size: for a diploid cohort the number of people is at most half of it, and the denominator is the cohort's total allele count, which dbSNP does not report here.

allele.description: The allele this frequency refers to. Note this is NOT always the minor or alternate allele -- dbSNP reports whichever allele the study submitted, so check it before comparing studies.

frequency.description: Frequency of 'allele' in this study, between 0 and 1

allele_count.description: Number of ALLELES (chromosomes) observed carrying 'allele' in this study -- the numerator of 'frequency'. This is the value after the slash in dbSNP's 'global_mafs' encoding 'allele=frequency/count'. It is NOT a count of individuals: for 1000 Genomes phase 3 (2504 samples = 5008 alleles), rs429358 gives 0.1505591 x 5008 = 754 and rs80338939 gives 0.002396 x 5008 = 12, so a study reporting 12 here observed 12 carrier chromosomes out of 5008, not a 12-person cohort. dbSNP does not report the denominator, so this number alone does not give study size.

sample_count.description: LEGACY MISNOMER retained for backwards compatibility -- identical in value to 'allele_count'. Despite the name this is the allele/chromosome count from dbSNP's 'global_mafs', NOT a number of individuals or a sample size. Prefer 'allele_count'.

total_studies.description: Number of studies with frequency data
